patrimoine.lead: The database of recorded heritage sites — their condition, listing status and location. Free for all. Spot a site, watch over it, report what you see.

patrimoine.charte.gratuit.1: Access to Heritage is entirely free — no payment, whether to browse or to contribute.
patrimoine.charte.gratuit.2: The __MARQUE__ app offers a two-week trial before subscription; the Heritage section, however, stays accessible without payment, even beyond that.
patrimoine.charte.gratuit.3: The heritage documented here is not merchandise: any attempt to monetise it is beyond our control.
patrimoine.charte.regles.1: Truthful, respectful contributions — no offensive, defamatory or off-topic content.
patrimoine.charte.regles.2: Photos you own the rights to, or that are free of rights, with their source.
patrimoine.charte.regles.3: Contributions are named and moderated before publication.
